title: Idea Redo
style: jazz, electronic future bass with new jazz influences, smooth jazzy chords, bright wobbly basslines, groovy electronic drums, modern nu-jazz production, positive and energetic vibe, clean male vocals with layered harmonies and call-and-response, futuristic yet soulful atmosphere, 138 BPM, breaks, smooth, jazzy, groovy, male vocals, soulful, bright, electronic, clean
lyrics:
[Intro]
Assume mode, no ask, just build
Hands to keys till the board is filled
One step done, next step real
Proof on disk, that is the deal
Yeah, no stop
Let me hear what you got for me to hear, safe and sound

[Verse 1]
No menu loop, no stall tonight
Short words, hard facts, keep the line tight
If it breaks, we log, if it works, we ship
No drift pattern, no lost grip

[Chorus]
Okay, hold up, it's not all luck
We all got this thing, let me make it ring
You can look, read ya book
Go on then, have a good look again
You can tell you what you want to
You can believe too if you want to
You really want to know? Think like that
Yeah, like that
Enough with the text, emotionless comments
No dislikes, I like
No dislikes, no dislikes
Yeah, that is what I like
We ain't going to roll like that
Stat, stat, stat, sing it back
From your chest to my content
Like a pen pal, my song pal

[Verse 2]
Assume mode stays
No stall phrase
Build it now
Lock it down
Yeah, no stop
Let me hear what you got

[Chorus]
No dislikes, I like
No dislikes, no dislikes
Yeah, that is what I like
We ain't going to roll like that
Stat, stat, stat, sing it back
From your chest to my content
Like a pen pal, my song pal
Assume mode, no ask, just build
Hands to keys till the board is filled

[Outro]
Yeah, no stop
Let me hear what you got
Safe and sound
